linkedin.text:
At our 2024 Future of Data Hackathon, a team walked in with nothing but curiosity and a caffeine plan. By dusk they had shipped a working prototype.

If you're a student, that's the day you want. You build something people will use, and someone who hires is watching.

So for the 2025 hackathon, we opened 40 student slots. We picked 40 because it was small enough for every student to get direct mentorship and time with the executives. It was also large enough to form diverse, high-functioning teams.

Each team was set to build for a nonprofit. When registration opened, Movers & Makers reported that both nonprofit partners had submitted operational problems for the teams to solve.

The executives were decision-makers coming to see who builds well under pressure. With only 40 students, your work stood a fair chance of being seen up close.

What would you build if you knew a decision-maker was watching?

Read the full post: https://disruptionnow.com/blog/40-student-slots-real-world-impact/
